description: Machine-readable chronology of the research and its publication. Each event names the published records it rests on. Dates are calendar dates in the stated time zone. 'date_status: unestablished' marks a fact that no preserved record dates. Target events carry target dates, never completion dates, until completion evidence exists. Read with evidence/TIMELINE_FACTS.md.

source_categories.document_header_date: the date written in a document's own header; not an independent timestamp
source_categories.audit_trail_order: the order of the preserved project commits; constrains sequence, not wall-clock time
source_categories.result_record: a value inside a preserved result or rule record
source_categories.maintainer_assertion: a statement by the person who did the work; an assertion, not an independent timestamp
source_categories.publication_record: a dated entry in this repository's changelog

required_wording.text: The initial research and primary E3 analysis were completed by 4 September 2026, as documented in the project records. Formal evidence preparation, documentation, reproducibility verification, and public release began on 19 September 2026. The target is to complete the evidence package by 28 September, with final verification and handoff by 29 September. Any further analysis is documented with its actual dates, methods, and results. Completion will be reported after verification.
